# Longer Term Non-committee Roles

The current holders of longer term (i.e. not only for events) positions that are 
not part of the committee are:

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(gt)

noncom <- read.csv("roles.csv") |>
    filter(Committee == "", Role != "Coach ") |>
    select(Role, Currently) |>
    rename("Currently held by" = Currently) |>
    gt() |>
    fmt_markdown(columns = Role)
noncom
```

If you are interested in becoming a Coach, see our dedicated [coaches page](coach.qmd).
